thread.title: Apple Stock Gets Price-Target Hike On Prospects For New iPhones

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: Apple Stock Gets Price-Target Hike On Prospects For New iPhones
text:
A brokerage firm on Friday raised its price target on Apple stock based on an improving outlook for the company's new smartphones set to debut this fall.
X Loop Capital analyst Ananda Baruah reiterated his buy rating on Apple ( AAPL ) and raised his price target to 210 from 195.
Apple stock rose 1.4% to 187.97
"We believe the stock is positioned net-positively for second-half 2018, although not without executional hurdles," Baruah said in a report.
 Apple will benefit from the introduction of a new lower-priced, LCD-screen iPhone in September, he said. Likely to be pitched as a midrange device, it will be priced below the current OLED-screen iPhone X and its expected successor, he said. The iPhone X is Apple's most expensive handset, starting at $1,000.

The new LCD iPhone and Apple's ongoing services momentum "can provide a tailwind" for the company's revenue, he said.
Also, Apple's $100 billion share buyback commenced in the June quarter and should provide a lift to earnings per share, Baruah said.
